purpose: Bounded provider/routing/admission compatibility classification. VERIFIED entries have direct executable regressions; PARTIAL entries identify the exact inherited provider-specific signature that still lacks end-to-end replay. No production fix is bundled into this investigation.

contracts.name: Embeddings Authorization propagation
contracts.note: Forced-exit execution passes 9/9 and directly asserts upstream Authorization forwarding for keyed providers plus no fabricated Authorization for keyless providers; leaked handles require Node's test-force-exit mode in this shared checkout.

contracts.name: OAuth refresh assigned-proxy confinement and proxy selection
contracts.note: Both direct refresh-proxy suites currently cancel with a pending Promise before assertions complete; the historical fail-closed implementation remains present but this corpus does not claim fresh executable verification.

contracts.name: Admission queue and execution timeout semantics
contracts.note: Queue depth, scheduling maxWaitMs, execution backstop, provider budgets, and adaptive cost behavior have direct unit coverage; this does not claim every upstream timeout implementation is identical.

contracts.name: Routing aliases and native Codex turn-pin fallback
contracts.note: Model-scoped pinning/fallback is directly covered; alias variants are covered elsewhere but not used to overstate this classification.

contracts.name: Codex Cloudflare challenge/input_tokens terminal classification
contracts.note: Generic auth/transient classification is tested, but the inherited Codex input_tokens Cloudflare challenge signature is not replayed end-to-end.

contracts.name: Custom provider baseUrl routing
contracts.note: Configured connection baseUrl wins and default behavior remains covered.

contracts.name: Combo target skipping and call-log behavior
contracts.note: Combo recovery/exhaustion diagnostics are covered; the exact inherited image/video sequential execution plus call-log-ID-collision signature is not replayed as one fixture.

contracts.name: Models discovery latency, fallback, and token-limit precedence
contracts.note: Live/fallback/cache behavior and token-limit precedence are covered; the inherited 75-120s latency/502 and explicit limit-ignored scenario is not replayed end-to-end.

contracts.name: AgentRouter GLM/Astra reasoning and routing contracts
contracts.note: GLM transport bounds have direct coverage, but the full inherited GLM adaptive-thinking and GPT-6 Astra context/timeout/405/tools+reasoning matrix is not replayed.

contracts.name: Provider reasoning-history continuity
contracts.note: Reasoning replay/opt-in behavior is directly covered across provider paths; provider-specific MiniMax think-tag behavior is not generalized beyond its own tests.

contracts.name: Model-sync catalog filtering and hidden variants
contracts.note: Catalog merge/filter fallback is covered; the exact inherited *:batch import plus hideAutoCombos/hideNoThinkVariants matrix is not replayed as one contract fixture.

contracts.name: Antigravity error-body, large-tool, search, and retest contracts
contracts.note: Non-OK upstream body handling is directly tested; the inherited ~357-tool, native web-search, and retest-body variants remain provider-specific replay gaps.

contracts.name: Claude/Responses prompt-cache continuity
contracts.note: Cache-control and prompt_cache_key/session-affinity preservation have direct translation coverage.

contracts.name: Gemini Web system/tools/multiline/model-selection behavior
contracts.note: Gemini Web auth/model registration/error/parser behavior is covered, but the exact inherited system/tools/multiline/slow-typing and stale-model-ID signatures are not all replayed.

contracts.name: Zed hosted Gemini safety/function-calling and Claude Haiku thinking limits
contracts.note: Zed-hosted stream formatting is tested, but the inherited safety/function-calling and Haiku max-token overflow signatures remain unreplayed.

contracts.name: AI/ML provider parser stale/null optionals
contracts.note: Provider parsing/filtering has adjacent coverage; the inherited AI/ML stale/null optional parser signature lacks a direct named replay.

contracts.name: Kiro profile/runtime and orphan tool-use continuity
contracts.note: Runtime endpoint/auth and interleaved tool-result continuity are covered; the exact profileArn fallback and repeated-large-doc prepend cases are not replayed together.

contracts.name: Alibaba/Bailian custom endpoint routing
contracts.note: Region presets and genuinely custom base URLs have direct precedence coverage.

contracts.name: Claude/Codex client-version identity compatibility
contracts.note: Codex catalog compatibility is tested, but Fable 5.1/GPT-6 Astra minimum client-identity negotiation is not directly replayed.

contracts.name: Groq Cloudflare 1010/custom transport
contracts.note: Groq provider behavior has unit coverage, but the inherited Cloudflare 1010/custom-transport signature is not directly replayed.

contracts.name: xAI/Grok usage.total_tokens normalization
contracts.note: Usage normalization/extraction is broadly tested, but the inherited xAI-specific total_tokens=0 signature lacks a direct provider fixture.

contracts.name: Audio transcription observability and cost logging
contracts.note: Successful/error transcription transport is covered; the inherited successful-transcription call-log/cost observability signature is not replayed end-to-end.
